case.title: 'We buy from the kiosk' on a vendor form: the kiosk decides, so it contradicts the form

submissions.open_text: The kiosk opens late so mornings are slow.

case.why: The source named is the kiosk (public tap or kiosk); 'buy from' only decides when nothing is named.
